representations.name: all-m integer constraint matrix
representations.new_information: Orders (g,f,b,r_1,...,r_m,q_1,...,q_m) and every source, complement and identity row explicitly.
representations.repairs_loss: Makes rank and redundancy uniform in m rather than extrapolated from one finite block.
representations.first_test: Delete the g column and exhibit a square unit triangular minor of order 2m+2.

representations.name: Smith-minor and primitive-kernel ledger
representations.new_information: Records a unimodular maximal minor, the exact integer kernel and quotient torsion.
representations.repairs_loss: Separates rational nullity from integer primitivity.
representations.first_test: Compute Smith invariants for m=1,...,24 and prove the displayed unit minor for symbolic m.

representations.name: constraint dependency bipartite graph
representations.new_information: Connects equations to variables and labels the m identity rows as consequences of b+g+f=0 plus paired observables.
representations.repairs_loss: Prevents redundant identities from being counted as new rank.
representations.first_test: Substitute the first four equation groups into b-r_i-q_i and reduce it identically to zero.

representations.name: source-only versus full observable quotient
representations.new_information: Compares the full matrix with the subsystem retaining g+r_i, f and all factor identities.
representations.repairs_loss: Keeps the common-spectrum shift separate from pure gauge.
representations.first_test: Verify source-only rank 2m+1 and kernel generated by gauge and spectrum shift.

representations.name: actual factor-incidence matrix extractor
representations.new_information: Builds variables and rows from actual identities F_i=GR_i, B=R_iQ_i, P_A0=GB and P_Ai=F0Q_i instead of assuming the template.
representations.repairs_loss: Detects extra factors, missing absolute rows, repeated indices and incompatible unit lattices.
representations.first_test: Compare every row of the finite paired-positive witness and then search the archive for a theorem giving the same complete list power-large.

representations.name: unit-lattice tensor and coefficient-unit audit
representations.new_information: Tensors scalar incidence with the ambient exponent lattice and separately records signs, coefficient units and torsion.
representations.repairs_loss: A one-coordinate primitive matrix cannot hide ambient units or coordinate coupling.
representations.first_test: Test whether the cited real block fixes one common Laurent ring and whether its coefficient ring has only harmless units.

representations.name: absolute-spectrum conditioning ledger
representations.new_information: Counts row-spectrum fibres and retained row/target occurrence mass before adding complement equations.
representations.repairs_loss: Fixing all absolute observables is charged rather than treated as free.
representations.first_test: The fixed-X spectrum shift must either have subpower range or produce a uniform distance-label gain.

representations.name: all-target collision-fibre ledger
representations.new_information: Tracks actual all-target pair occurrences, label fibres and outer-stability losses after unit conditioning.
representations.repairs_loss: Connects a local matrix conclusion to the sole 28/9-capacity point-pair domain.
representations.first_test: Require t^(28/9-o(1)) retained occurrences and maximum fibre below t^(1/9-epsilon).
